LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.Smartstore.PayOS
LocaleResource.Value: Accepts VietQR bank transfers via PayOS and marks orders as paid automatically.

LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.FriendlyName.Payments.PayOS
LocaleResource.Value: Bank transfer via VietQR (PayOS)

LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.PaymentInfo.Payments.PayOS
LocaleResource.Value: After placing the order you will be redirected to PayOS. Scan the VietQR code with your banking app; the order is confirmed automatically once the transfer arrives.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value:
To set up PayOS:

  • Sign in at my.payos.vn, create a payment channel and link your bank account.
  • Copy Client ID, API Key and Checksum Key of the channel into the fields below and save.
  • Click Confirm webhook to register the webhook URL with PayOS. The shop must be reachable via a public HTTPS domain.
  • The working currency of the customers must be VND. PayOS is hidden for other currencies.
  • Enable Allow re-posting payments in the payment settings so customers can pay later from the order details page.
